Under legacy semantics, the default `"auto"` resolves to `"multiindex"`, and explicitly selecting `"multiindex"` likewise makes `flat` false. `create_model` still obtains `sns` through the unchanged `as_index(n, snapshots, "snapshots")` call and passes that same `sns` to the variable and constraint builders; the added context does not flatten component data when `flat` is false. Changes inside builders do not establish a change to the snapshots handed to them.
